text:
Samuel: Hey team — quick heads up. I've been having some wrist/forearm pain for the last couple weeks after long pairing sessions. Saw a doc yesterday; they recommended an ergonomic keyboard + vertical mouse and told me to reduce long continuous typing blocks. Can we start an accommodation request? Prefer expedited equipment + a temporary core-hours change (10:00–16:00) for 3–4 weeks if possible.

Jordan (Eng Manager): Thanks for flagging this, Sam. I noticed a bit of a slowdown on PR turnaround the past 2 weeks. I fully support getting you the equipment and flexible hours. We'll cover async reviews in the meantime.

Maria (People Ops): Thanks for reporting — we can start the interactive process. Please fill out the short accommodation form: https://redwood.internal/hr/accomms-form (or DM me if you'd rather). If you have a doctor's note, upload it to the secure form; it's helpful but not always required. We'll fast-track equipment requests. @Alex (IT) can you check stock for ergonomic kit?

Alex (IT): Ack. We have 2x Kinesis Advantage and 3x Logitech MX Vertical mice in stock. Sam — which keyboard do you prefer? We can ship to your home next-day once People Ops signs off.

Samuel: Kinesis would be ideal. Shipping to my home is fine — I'll DM the address. The flexible core hours would be 10–16 for 4 weeks to start. Also want to confirm this won't automatically trigger any performance actions — just requesting the accommodation first.

Maria (People Ops): Noted. We'll mark this as provisional 4-week accommodation while we monitor. It does not automatically trigger disciplinary action. We'll handle staffing changes at the manager level. Confidential reminder: please keep medical specifics out of the public channel, use DM or the secure form for PHI.

hr-bot: Automated notice — Accommodation request logged (case ACM-2024-0821). Case owner: Maria (People Ops). Please avoid posting sensitive medical attachments here. :lock:

Jordan (Eng Manager): I'll rearrange standup duties and async review owners so Sam isn't blocked. We'll pause any formal performance action until we complete the accommodation check and do a 2-week follow-up.

Samuel: Appreciate that. One quick q: will the temporary schedule affect PTO accrual or salary? Don't want surprises.

Maria (People Ops): Short answer: no impact to pay or accrual for this temporary adjustment. If we need to extend beyond 4 weeks we'll evaluate with documentation and confirm in writing. I'll DM you the policy excerpt and next steps.

Alex (IT): Shipping label created — Tracking #TRACK12345 — ETA 1 business day. I can do a remote setup + ergonomics check over Zoom once it arrives, if you want.

Samuel: Got the tracking, thanks. Remote setup/ergonomics session would be great.

Maria (People Ops): Great. I'll schedule the 1:1 intake with Sam for tomorrow and set a 2-week follow-up reminder. Closing initial coordination here but please update the case in the secure portal. :white_check_mark:
